description: This file defines the CandidateAttachment entity class for the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin, representing file attachments associated with candidates in the HRM system. It includes properties for attachment metadata and content, along with ORM mappings.

classes.name: CandidateAttachment
classes.description: Entity class representing candidate attachment files, mapped to the database table 'ohrm_job_candidate_attachment'.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the attachment.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the attachment.

methods.name: setCandidate
methods.description: Associates a Candidate entity with this attachment.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Gets the name of the attachment file.

methods.name: setFileName
methods.description: Sets the name of the attachment file.

methods.name: getFileType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type of the attachment, if set.

methods.name: setFileType
methods.description: Sets the MIME type of the attachment.

methods.name: getFileSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the file in bytes.

methods.name: setFileSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the file in bytes.

methods.name: getFileContent
methods.description: Retrieves the file content, as resource or string.

methods.name: setFileContent
methods.description: Sets the file content; expects a string.

methods.name: getAttachmentType
methods.description: Gets the optional attachment type identifier.

methods.name: setAttachmentType
methods.description: Sets the optional attachment type identifier.
